column1: # Extra ports manifest for obsd-ports (packages absent from official OpenBSD release ports.tar.gz).
#   port          -- <category>/<name> path under extra/ (must use an official OpenBSD category and never collide with ports/)
#   category      -- primary OpenBSD ports category (e.g. devel, misc, sysutils, textproc, net, www)
#   pkgname_base  -- upstream package stem (e.g. goose, forgecode, aichat)
#   upstream_url  -- canonical upstream repository or homepage URL
#   jit_free      -- yes (mandatory W^X / WASM64 / iOS zero-JIT compliance)
#   versions      -- supported OPENBSD_VERSION values (* or comma-separated subset of 7.8,7.9,8.0)
#   backends      -- supported COMPAT_BACKEND values (* or comma-separated subset of emulate,translate)
#   pals          -- supported COMPAT_PAL values (* or comma-separated subset of emscripten,wasi,darwin,ios,linux)
